mask.trackAttachHint: The mask is standing still. Attach a motion track to this clip so the mask follows the object.
mask.trackFollow: 🎯 The mask is following the motion track — the mask center moves along the trajectory attached to this clip (detaching the trajectory stops both the clip and the mask).

motionTrack.assIgnored: ⚠️ This text clip is drawn with ASS ({reason}), so the motion track is ignored at render — the text stays still (see D3_LIMITS.md).
motionTrack.maskNotFollowing: The mask does not follow the track either.
motionTrack.transitionIgnored: ⚠️ This clip has a transition, so the motion track is ignored on the merged unit (see D3_LIMITS.md).
motionTrack.maskStillFollows: The mask still follows the track through the transition (only the clip's shift is skipped on the merged unit).

mask.trackAttachHint: Mask đang đứng yên. Gắn motion track cho clip để mask bám theo vật thể.
mask.trackFollow: 🎯 Mask đang bám theo motion track — tâm mask di chuyển theo quỹ đạo gắn trên clip (gỡ quỹ đạo sẽ dừng cả clip lẫn mask).

motionTrack.assIgnored: ⚠️ Clip chữ vẽ bằng ASS ({reason}) nên motion track bị bỏ qua khi render — chữ giữ vị trí tĩnh (xem D3_LIMITS.md).
motionTrack.maskNotFollowing: Mask cũng không bám theo track.
motionTrack.transitionIgnored: ⚠️ Clip có transition nên motion track bị bỏ qua ở unit đã merge (xem D3_LIMITS.md).
motionTrack.maskStillFollows: Mask vẫn bám theo track qua đoạn transition (chỉ phần dịch chuyển của clip bị bỏ qua ở đoạn merge).
